leadText:
Jinny (Japanese: ナミ Nami) is a character of the day who appeared in The Cuteness Quotient!. She is a friend of Parker's.

After receiving her , Jinny was being picked on by the other kindergarteners, who believed it wasn't a cute Pokémon at all. Parker called on his older sister Chloe's help, who enlisted Goh and . They took Jinny to the Cerise Laboratory, where Feebas spent time with all of the Pokémon residing there. Upon learning of the Friendship Festival taking place in Slateport City, Chloe and the others helped Jinny Feebas in preparation for the competition, including learning how to swim.

Jinny later visited Slateport City with her team of supporters and entered the festival, which was also streamed online for her classmates back home to watch. Her performance was interrupted by , who went on to steal all of the Pokémon. Jinny protected Feebas from 's claws before it evolved into a and sent Team Rocket blasting off. Jinny later received a special award for the performance, her strong bond with Milotic, and the Evolution. Back home, the children apologized to Jinny for insulting Feebas and joined her in playing with Milotic.

She was mentioned in by Parker in Memories of a Warming Kindness!.
